scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
other_conditions: Must have qualified NET‑JRF or the UGC‑CSIR Joint Test.
Must register for M.Phil/Ph.D. in a recognized university/institution/college within two years of the result declaration, award letter issuance, or fellowship joining date.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly fellowship of ₹37,000 for two years (JRF) and ₹42,000 for the remaining three years (SRF), along with contingent allowances and housing support.
